protocol.checkpoint_selection: Ultralytics best.pt selected using validation fitness only
protocol.counting_mae_definition: mean absolute error across image-class cells (N times 5); also report sum-count MAE
protocol.exact_count_accuracy_definition: fraction of images whose entire five-class count vector matches
protocol.test_policy: No test inference, evaluation, selection, or tuning.
protocol.size_claims: Red Bull sizes are not separate labels, so size accuracy cannot be measured.

precision_recall_note: Ultralytics P/R at its validation F1 operating point; not necessarily confidence 0.25. AP uses the 0.001 confidence floor.
